server.name: io.github.Agonx402/agon-protocol
server.description: MCP server for Agon Protocol state reads and prepare-only payment-channel actions.

environmentVariables.description: Optional Solana devnet RPC URL.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_DEVNET_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional Agon Protocol program ID. Defaults to the live devnet deployment.
environmentVariables.name: AGON_PROTOCOL_PROGRAM_ID

environmentVariables.description: Official devnet USDC token ID in the deployed Agon token registry.
environmentVariables.name: AGON_PROTOCOL_DEVNET_USDC_TOKEN_ID
